annotations.title: Request a human sign-off (four-eyes review) before acting

description: Request that a named human reviews a consequential agent action against your criteria and returns approve / reject / escalate with reasons and an audit record. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually, with volume tiers.

basis.description: Data, reasons and context the action is based on.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

deadline.description: Optional: latest time for the decision.

proposed_action.description: The action the agent wants to take.
